recipes.name: Tiramisu inspired by Superbad
ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, divided (two equal parts)
8 ounces of room temperature mascarpone cheese
instructions: In the bowl of a stand mixer, add large egg yolks and ¼ cup of the sugar and whisk together on half speed for about 2 minutes or until pale, yellow, and ribbony. - 3 large egg yolks - ½ cup granulated sugar divided (two equal parts)
While the mixer is running, add any extract of your choice such as vanilla or almond. Set this mixture aside for later. - ½ tsp flavoring extract of choice

Into another bowl of a stand mixer, whisk egg whites on medium speed until they start to get light and foamy. Slowly stream in the remaining sugar and continue whisking for about 2 to 3 minutes until it holds stiff peaks. - 4 egg whites room temperature - ½ cup granulated sugar divided (two equal parts)

Add the egg yolk mixture to the egg white mixture and gently fold together until almost combined, but still streaky. Sift all purpose flour into the mixture to prevent lumps. Gently fold together and make sure not to release all of the air out of the batter. - 3 large egg yolks - ½ cup granulated sugar divided (two equal parts) - ½ tsp flavoring extract of choice - 4 egg whites room temperature - 1 cup all purpose flour
Using a piping bag or a Ziploc bag with the corner cut off, pipe the batter onto a parchment lined baking sheet and bake at 375°F for about 14 minutes. - For the Ladyfingers
Make sure to carefully rotate them once while they are baking. Once the baking is completed, they should be light, crisp, and golden brown.
Once the ladyfingers are fully cooled, gently pull them off the parchment paper. - For the Ladyfingers

In the bowl of a stand mixer, add egg yolks and ¼ cup of sugar and whisk for about 3 minutes on medium-high speed until tripled in volume. Set aside for later and clean off your whisk attachment. - 4 egg yolks - ½ cup sugar divided

In a separate bowl of the stand mixer, beat heavy cream and the remaining sugar for about 1 to 2 minutes on medium-high speed until you end up with medium peaks. - ¾ cup heavy cream - ½ cup sugar divided
Add room-temperature mascarpone cheese and beat for about 30 seconds to 1 minute until it is thick and spreadable. - 8 ounces of room temperature mascarpone cheese
Add the egg yolk mixture to the whipped cream mixture and stir until combined. - 4 egg yolks - ½ cup sugar divided - ¾ cup heavy cream - 8 ounces of room temperature mascarpone cheese
Spread a little bit of custard in the bottom of a ring mold or a springform pan. Line the inside rim with ladyfingers rounded side out. - For the Ladyfingers

For layering, dunk some smaller ladyfingers into some cooled off espresso with an optional splash of dark rum or amaretto and arrange as many of them as possible in a single layer lined up in the bottom of the pan. If necessary, cut up the ladyfingers if there are any large gaps that need to be filled in. - Ladyfingers - Cooled espresso - Dark rum or amaretto (optional)

Add just enough custard to cover the coffee soaked ladyfingers and repeat until the mold is nearly filled to the top. Top it off with a little dusting of cocoa powder. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 to 24 hours until it is nice and firm. - For the Custard - Cocoa powder
